Last week I posted about China shutting down the Taiwan Strait with a 40-day airspace closure no announced exercise, no explanation. Just SFC-UNL ceiling and silence.

Now look at this 👇
Taiwan just launched disaster response drills across 11 cities and counties starting April 11. Emergency services activated. Chains of command tested. Civilian attention split inward.

Same playbook as December.
Remember Christmas? China surrounded Taiwan with Justice Mission 2025  record 7 zones, live-fire blockade drills. Taiwan ran internal enforcement sweeps during that window. Philippines executed corruption takedowns simultaneously while running bilateral maritime drills with the US.

Now in Q2: 
🔴 China 40-day airspace lockdown, 17 PLA sorties crossing the median line on April 11 
🔴 Taiwan  11-city Urban Resilience Exercises + Han Kuang tabletop wargames (longest ever at 14 days) 
🔴 Philippines Japan deploying combat troops to Philippine soil for the first time since WWII. Balikatan runs April 20 through late May. Salaknib already live. 
🔴 US/Australia/Philippines trilateral maritime drills April 9-12 in the South China Sea
China clears the corridor. Taiwan activates emergency infrastructure. Allied forces position across the theater. New quarter. New sweep.
Rinse Repeat Enjoy The Show @homeranger17 @drawandstrike

Drivers are encouraged to expect delays and seek an alternate route. The call was received at 3:05 p.m.

More information will be released as it becomes available. This is an active and ongoing investigation.
